name: Property inspector
summary: A card of editable properties: a layout toggle, number fields for size, radius, and opacity, a type select, and an Adjust action that marks the panel edited.

useWhen: Editing a few properties of one selected object in a side panel
Showing that a panel holds edits, with a Reset beside the status
avoidWhen: The values must be saved or checked by a server
The panel needs many property groups or a tree of objects

accessibility: The section is named by its Promo banner heading, and the Layout group has its own heading.
The layout options are a ToggleButtonGroup named Layout whose options are named Row, Column, and Grid by aria-label, and one option always stays selected.
Each NumberField has a visible label and Increase and Decrease buttons, and Opacity reads as a percent from 0 to 100.
The Type Select is named by its visible Type label.
Adjust becomes Reset in the same button, so focus stays on it, and the Edited text is a role=status element.
unsupported: Saving: the values are placeholders, and Reset restores the first ones
Applying the layout, size, radius, opacity, or type to anything
Dragging a field to change its value
workflowValue: Replaces wiring a property panel by hand: one values object drives the toggle, the number fields, and the select, and one edited flag swaps Adjust for Reset, so you swap the properties and keep the card.
